description: This file defines the HLookup class, which implements the HLOOKUP function for spreadsheet calculations, including methods for performing lookups, array conversions, and search logic within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: HLookup
classes.description: Class implementing the HLOOKUP function for spreadsheet calculations, including methods for lookup operations and array handling.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs an HLOOKUP operation to find a value in the top row of an array and return a corresponding value from a specified row.

methods.name: hLookupSearch
methods.description: Searches for a lookup value within a specific column of the lookup array, supporting exact and approximate matches.

methods.name: convertLiteralArray
methods.description: Converts a literal array into a structured array with column indices as keys.
